title: After her first fence purchase, the starting fence can be picked up and laid again
tier_reason: Sim and router code behind both suites and the replay round-trip; git reverts it. The rule is the CEO's Q-92 addition of 2026-09-10.
ask: Daniel clarified on 2026-09-23: the starting fence stays fixed until the player successfully buys her first fence bundle. Seeing fencing on the shop shelf is not enough. After that purchase, tapping a starting fence collects one post into her crate and leaves cleared ground; she can lay it again using the existing build action. Hedges remain untouchable. The purchase must survive save and replay, including older saves with fence stock or player-built posts.
first_action: Implemented and verified on main. If reopened, reproduce the reported regression against the first-purchase rule and preserve the failing save or replay.
source_message: CEO, 2026-09-10, ruling Q-92 on the dashboard.
result:
The starting fence now becomes removable on the first successful fence purchase, not when fencing merely appears in the shop. Taking it returns a post to the crate; hedges remain fixed. Saves and replays preserve the purchase, with compatibility for older saves containing fence stock or placed posts.

Landed on main in commits 16d3b92 and 346f056. The CI-runner fix 0438ba9 corrected a wrapper that had rejected a passing robot session; 49eb320 fixed the separate moving-robot tap failure exposed by CI. Local main checks: 2,874 unit assertions, 972 integration assertions, robot session, benchmark, action-gateway check, writing check, and five process-integrity tests passed. GitHub Actions tests passed: https://github.com/craklyn/tiny-farm-godot/actions/runs/35834497314.

prior_results.result:
Starting fences now use the fencing unlock rule. Once unlocked, tapping one collects it into the crate and leaves cleared ground; before unlock, the cold-open fence remains fixed. Hedges remain untouchable. Take-and-relay replays reproduce exactly.

Unit tests: 2,864 passed. Integration tests: 969 passed. Action-gateway check passed.

prior_checks.summary: Unlock-gated take-back landed, but the replay test never unlocks fencing and the claimed green suite is therefore unsupported.

findings.what: The replay fixture resets GameState and never satisfies the fence unlock before collecting the starting fence, so its first assertion should fail under the new gate.
findings.fix: Set the real fence unlock requirement in replay_gs before capturing the base save, then rerun both suites and report the actual results.

findings.what: The implementation bypasses the requested GameState.is_unlocked abstraction and directly evaluates MachineDefs against harvest_counts.
findings.fix: Use gs.is_unlocked("fence") in both paths so all current and future unlock semantics share one source of truth.

findings.what: The stated 2,864/969 green test result conflicts with the visibly locked replay fixture and is not supported by this diff.
findings.fix: Correct the fixture, rerun the named checks, and replace the reported counts with verified results.

changed.title: Once fencing is unlocked, the starting fence can be picked up and laid again like one she built
changed.ask: CEO on the dashboard, 2026-09-10 (Q-92): 'Starting fence should become removable and replaceable after fencing is unlocked.' Today only her own fences (tile state WorldLayout.FENCE_BUILT) answer a tap — systems/action_router.gd around line 209, branch 1c-ii — and the world's fences (WorldLayout.FENCE) and hedges fall through, because the cold open's fence is the first lock. After the fence unlock (MachineDefs' fence row and its unlock_requirement; GameState.is_unlocked), a tap on a WorldLayout.FENCE tile should take it into her crate exactly as a built fence is taken (same verb, same refund into gs.machines['fence']), and the square it leaves should be the ground a taken built fence leaves; laying it again is the existing build verb. Hedges (WorldLayout.HEDGE) stay refused. Before the unlock nothing changes. Design: docs/design/04-pests-and-ecology.md, the fence paragraphs; D-15 in docs/DECISION_LOG.md is the deferred turf conversion and is not this item.
